sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Sabetha stays rooted the whole fight, but each health threshold (75/50/25%) swaps in a new miniboss with its own priority mechanic — on top of her own attacks running continuously. 9-minute enrage.

sections.heading: Sabetha's attacks (throughout)
bullets: <mark>Firestorm</mark> (the "Flame Wall"): every 45 seconds she unleashes a wall of fire that slowly rotates counter-clockwise around the arena — anyone touched by it is instantly killed, so keep moving with the rotation.

<mark>Time Bomb</mark>: the closest player gets tagged (large orange circle) and it detonates after 3 seconds for heavy area damage — move away from the group immediately. Below 50% HP, two players get tagged at once instead of one.
<mark>Flak Shot</mark>: targets the furthest player and leaves burning tar fields on the ground — don't stand in them.
<mark>Heat</mark>: a close-range shotgun blast at nearby players — melee should stay alert for it rather than tunnel-visioning on rotation.
<mark>Platform Crush</mark>: only kicks in below 25% health — random dark orange circles of falling debris across the platform, on top of everything else.
Cannons spawn every 30 seconds — designated players need Sapper Bombs to reach and use them.

sections.heading: Minibosses by phase
bullets: 75% — Kernan: fires three shotgun blasts at the closest player. Sidestep each one rather than trying to block or dodge-cancel through them.
50% — Knuckles: his defiance bar is a top priority — if it isn't broken in time, he knocks players up and flings them a long way back.
25% — Karde: uses a flamethrower on the closest player and spawns Flame Turrets around the platform — ranged players should dispatch the turrets quickly.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 9:00 — at enrage all four cannons activate at once and Sabetha's outgoing damage jumps +500%. Treat it as a hard wall.
